verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a core {{query}} feature for asking questions of the knowledge base, which is the basis for structured querying, but the evidence pack never describes property-based filtering, advanced/datalog queries, or table/board/list view rendering that the story specifically asks about. missing for 10: documentation of querying by page/block properties, evidence of table/board/list view outputs from queries, and any independent confirmation of these query views working in practice.
